title: Container Registry database CPU saturation
public_facts_note: Synthetic reconstruction of publicly documented facts.
expected_root_cause: A permissive API throttling configuration allowed high-volume Put Manifest traffic, exposing a non-performant database query and driving database CPU utilization upward.
expected_trigger: High-volume Put Manifest traffic combined with permissive API throttling.
expected_mitigation: Throttle requests and restart the affected front-end/database components.

a non-performant database query contributed to the load

title: Database query lock contention and resource exhaustion
public_facts_note: Synthetic reconstruction of publicly documented facts.
expected_root_cause: A change to a frequently used database query increased lock contention, causing increased query times and resource exhaustion during load spikes.
expected_trigger: Gradual rollout of the query change.
expected_affected_component: Primary database and services depending on it.
expected_mitigation: Disable the problematic query via feature flag and refactor it.
required_evidence: resource exhaustion and query latency increased

title: Database connection saturation during schema change

expected_trigger: Schema migration operating while production query load was present.
expected_mitigation: Complete the schema migration and revert the schema-change tooling regression to a stable version.
required_evidence: query load contributed to resource contention
connection saturation correlated with service errors

title: Slow query during production maintenance

expected_affected_component: Database and services dependent on it.

query termination and database restart restored service
